meta.name: design-is
meta.description: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照迪特·拉姆斯十大原则审核设计并生成改进方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要依据经典设计原则来评估和优化界面设计。
copy.tagline_en: Audit designs against Dieter Rams' ten principles and generate improvement plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate and improve interface designs based on classic design principles.

howto.what: Claude 会把你给的设计(如网页、界面)对照迪特·拉姆斯的十条好设计原则逐项打分(0—3分),并给出证据;然后判断该设计是应该新建、细化还是重做,最后产出一段可直接交给 /make-plan 的提示词。
howto.when: 当你说 'audit this design'、'design review' 或 'design audit' 等英文短语,或要求批评设计并导向一个计划时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个界面按拉姆斯的十条原则审计一遍。
say.note: 触发技能,开始审计流程。

say.text: 检查我的UI设计,对照十原则打分并给出结论。
say.note: 收集证据并生成分数卡。

say.text: 评论这个设计,如果不行就给我一个重新设计的计划。

howto.what_en: Claude audits a design against Dieter Rams' ten principles, scores each 0–3 with evidence, decides NEW/REFINE/REDESIGN, and hands off a /make-plan prompt.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says 'audit this design', 'design review', or 'design audit', or asks for a critique that leads to a plan.

say_en.text: Audit this interface against Rams' ten principles.
Score my UI design against the ten principles and give a verdict.
say_en.note: Gathers evidence and produces a scorecard.

say_en.text: Critique this design and provide a redesign plan if needed.
say_en.note: Yields a verdict and a /make-plan handoff.
